transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what brings you here today?

I came in because... well, the thought of getting on an airplane right now just scares me so bad. I know it doesn't make any sense, but my body just tells me that the plane is going to fall. It's gotten to the point where I just can't do it.
Is this fear you're feeling specific to flying, or do you experience similar feelings in other situations as well?
No, it's really just flying. I mean, I don't have any problems driving or taking the train or anything like that. It's just... being up in the air. That's the only thing that sets it off.
